name: kimi_k3_kda_prefill_checkpoint_strided_rows_n_heads12_head_dim128
description: Kimi-K3's KDA prefill (chunked gated delta rule), every sequence's tokens back to back: sequence s owns rows cu_seqlens[s]:cu_seqlens[s + 1] and slot state_indices[s] of state_cache, whose head h holds the state S[v, k] = state_cache[slot, h * head_dim + v, k]. Per head, q and k are L2-normalized (x / sqrt(sum(x**2) + 1e-6)) and q multiplied by scale; the gate g = lower_bound * sigmoid(exp(a_log[h]) * (raw_g + g_bias[h])) per channel; beta = sigmoid(raw_beta). A sequence starts from its slot's state when has_initial_state[s], else from zero (the slot then holds stale values no kernel reads); token by token, S = S * exp(g)[None, :], S = S + beta * (v - S @ k)[:, None] * k[None, :], out = S @ q; its last S is written back to its slot. Slots no sequence names are left unchanged. Besides, as vLLM snapshots a state mid-prefill under prefix caching (its checkpoint_offsets, here in chunks of 64 tokens): where 0 < 64 * checkpoint_chunks[s] < sequence s's length, its state after its first 64 * checkpoint_chunks[s] tokens is written to checkpoint_state[s]; else checkpoint_state[s] is left as it was.

n_tokens.description: Tokens of every sequence, back to back.

head_dim.description: Width of every q, k, v and gate head, and the side of a head's square state.

state_rows.description: Rows of one slot: every head's state, v by v.

q.description: Queries after the short convolution, before the L2 norm.

k.description: Keys after the short convolution, before the L2 norm.

raw_g.description: The full-rank gate projection (f_b_proj's output), before g_bias and the activation.

raw_beta.description: The beta projection, one per token and head, before the sigmoid.

a_log.description: Log of each head's gate scale (vLLM's A_log).

g_bias.description: The gate's per-channel bias (vLLM's dt_bias, flat (n_heads * head_dim)).

state_cache.description: The paged recurrent states: slot by slot, each head's (v, k) state, the head's head_dim rows of head_dim keys.

has_initial_state.description: Whether each sequence resumes from its slot's state, else from zero.

cu_seqlens.description: Where each sequence's tokens start, then where the last ends.

checkpoint_chunks.description: Each sequence's snapshot point in chunks of 64 tokens; 0, or one at or past the sequence's end, asks for none.

checkpoint_state.description: Each sequence's snapshot: its heads' (v, k) states, as a slot of state_cache holds them.

scale.description: Multiplies the normalized queries; vLLM passes head_dim ** -0.5.

lower_bound.description: The gate's floor per token (Kimi-K3's gate_lower_bound); vLLM asserts it in [-5, 0).

out.description: Each token's S @ q after its update.
